candidate.derivedAnswer: D. From the origin, move 2 units left, then 3 units up.

methods.label: Interpret the signed coordinates
methods.explanation: The x-coordinate \(-2\) means moving \(2\) units left along the x-axis, and the y-coordinate \(3\) means then moving \(3\) units up parallel to the y-axis.
methods.levelReason: The method uses Grade 7 coordinate conventions and signed positions on number lines.
